description: Returns one package by its id: name, one-line summary, price, number of seats where limited, and page URL, plus the disclaimers. Use list_packages first if the id is unknown. Returns an error for an id that is not one of the seven.

id.description: Package id, lowercase. One of: lava (daily access), vindex (Oracle reports), magma (activity directory), oms (business order management), reseller, franchise, tycoon.

name: get_package
